title: Proposed C6 fixed error body
description: Closed three-field error envelope from BRIEF-C6-RELAY; the nine codes and HTTP mappings are INVENTED for C's fixed-copy review. HTTP status is transport metadata, not a body member: 400 REQUEST_INVALID; 403 AUTH_REQUIRED, USER_NOT_NAMED, OPT_IN_REQUIRED; 409 SESSION_REQUEST_REPLAYED; 429 SESSION_CAP_REACHED; 503 CAP_NOT_VERIFIED, ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE, RELAY_UNAVAILABLE, each prefixed COACH_. No provider text, SDP, credential, billing figure or partial success may be appended. Structural validation alone cannot establish a refusal happened before any provider creation.

nonce.description: INVENTED convention: null when the request has no valid lowercase UUIDv4 nonce; otherwise echo that exact request nonce, including when another field is invalid. A standalone response schema cannot enforce this cross-message relationship. Never reflect an invalid string.
